Class RtsFog (RefCounted), stateless: stamp(map_w:int, map_h:int, cells:PackedInt32Array /*source cell index y*map_w+x, ascending order irrelevant*/, sights:PackedFloat64Array /*per source, same length*/, explored:PackedByteArray /*0/1, size map_w*map_h*/) -> PackedByteArray vis (0/1).
